name: jev.triage
description: Level 2 multiple choice: route an inbound item to its handling lane.

lane.instructions: Which handling lane does this item belong to

criteria.coding: Write, fix, refactor, debug, review, or ship code
criteria.gtm-content: LinkedIn posts, emails, newsletters or newsletter sections, campaigns, outreach copy: writing or reshaping content for an audience
criteria.scheduling: Calendar, reminders, meeting logistics, time blocks, appointments: the item is about the time slot itself, not the family or health matter behind it
criteria.research: Find out, investigate, summarize what changed, compare, verify facts or sources: gathering or checking facts, not writing content for an audience
criteria.finance: Money, invoices, pricing, budgets, spend approval
criteria.fleet-ops: Agents, crons, hooks, models, machines, deploys, servers
criteria.personal: Family, kids and their school, health or sickness, gym, household, errands
criteria.security: Credentials, permissions, secret exposure, access changes
criteria.chatter: A short social reply that asks for nothing: thanks, ack, see you tomorrow
criteria.other: Outside every other lane: sports prediction, translation, trivia, general knowledge question

rules.reason: lane confidence at or below 0.90: human or meta-router decides
no listed lane fits: human or meta-router decides

notes.verdicts: PASS = routed to the chosen lane (confidence above 0.90, lane is not 'other'). ESCALATE = human queue (confidence at/below 0.90 or lane 'other'). Never BLOCKs.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
notes.criteria_edit_2026-09-28: personal vs scheduling disambiguated (kid sick -> notify school scored personal at confidence 0.90)
notes.criteria_edit_2026-09-28b: gtm-content (write for an audience) vs research (gather facts) disambiguated
